{{CSGO}}: 2012-11-04 }} '''Natus Vincere''' (Latin for "born to win", often abbreviated to '''NAVI''' and previously '''Na`Vi''') is a [[:category:Ukraine|Ukrainian]] professional esports organization.
They were the first team to win all [[Counter-Strike_Majors|''Counter-Strike'' Majors]] in one calendar year, with [[Intel_Extreme_Masters/Season_IV/World_Championship|Intel Extreme Masters IV]], [[Electronic_Sports_World_Cup/2010|ESWC 2010]], and [[World_Cyber_Games/2010|WCG 2010]], and the first team to win a [[Majors|''Global Offensive'' Major]] without dropping a map, doing so at [[PGL Major Stockholm 2021]]. NAVI also made history as the first team to win a ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' Major, claiming victory at [[PGL/2024/Copenhagen|PGL Major Copenhagen 2024]]. ==History== {{See also|Natus Vincere/History|l1=History of Natus Vincere}} ===Timeline=== {{Tabs dynamic |name1=2009 |name2=2010 |name3=2011 |name4=2012 |name5=2013 |name6=2015 |name7=2016 |name8=2017 |name9=2018 |name10=2019 |name11=2020 |name12=2021 |name13=2022 |name14=2023 |name15=2024 |name16=2025 |name17=2026 |This=17 |content1= *December 17th - {{CSGO}}: 2012-08-10 }} '''Ninjas in Pyjamas''' (often abbreviated to '''NIP''' and '''NiP''') is a [[:Category:Sweden|Swedish]] esports organization founded in 2000. The team competed in ''[[Counter-Strike]]'' until their dissolution in 2002. The team returned a first time in 2005 before being dissolved in 2007. In 2012, the team returned again, this time with a now heavily renowned ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' squad, which went on a record-breaking [[List_of_Longest_LAN_winning_streaks|87-0 map win streak]]. The longstanding duo of Christopher "[[GeT_RiGhT]]" Alesund and Patrik "[[f0rest]]" Lindberg, who were a core part of the initial team, departed from the organization after the end of the [[StarLadder/2019/Major|StarLadder Berlin Major]]. ==Timeline== {{Tabs dynamic |name1=2000 |name2=2001 |name3=2002 |name4=2005 |name5=2006 |name6=2007 |name7=2012 |name8=2014 |name9=2015 |name10=2016 |name11=2017 |name12=2018 |name13=2019 |name14=2020 |name15=2021 |name16=2022 |name17=2023 |name18=2024 |name19=2025 |name20=2026 |This=20 |content1= *June -
